candidates.snippet: 1900: Elected to Parliament - Winston Churchill was first elected as a Member of Parliament for Oldham. 1914: Appointed First Lord of the Admiralty - Churchill took on the crucial role of First Lord of the Admiralty at the outset of World War I. 1940: Becomes Prime Minister - Winston Churchill became Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, leading the nation through World War II. 1953: Awarded Nobel Prize in Literature - Churchill received the Nobel Prize in Literature for his mastery of historical and biographical description, as well as for brilliant oratory.
